def transform(grid):
    """Map the larger of the two colors to 0 and the smaller to the larger."""
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row})
    if len(colors) == 1:
        return [[0 for _ in row] for row in grid]
    low, high = colors[0], colors[-1]
    return [[high if v == low else 0 if v == high else v for v in row] for row in grid]
